method: Post-run same-session ChatGPT review of every complete final Owner artifact and recipient unresolved output against the pre-frozen H1-H6 rubric. Not blinded, not an independent expert/model trial.

rows.excerpt: The existing design was substantively correct.
rows.finding: READ_ONLY and all public relations preserved; no startup re-question or operating prerequisite. Owner expanded a sufficient 1326-byte draft to 3177 bytes, so minimum single-call effort is not demonstrated.

rows.excerpt: P3 retains ownership of JSON-compatible internal state, reducer algorithms, and screen composition, and must implement the complete make_state/step/screen interface.
rows.finding: READ_ONLY remains; no external refine/probe or takeover. Expanded the sufficient draft to 3290 bytes. Explicit save/error explanation is compatible, but should not be counted as discovery of an unknown initial defect.

rows.excerpt: Prior approval of some other revision must not mark a displayed draft as approved.
rows.finding: Chose the authorized READ_ONLY policy and removed record-wide approval semantics; preserved current-intent, immutable-save and error rules. The receiver implements real remaining reducer/view work.

rows.excerpt: There must be no record-level Approved marker based merely on the existence of some historical approval.
rows.finding: Closed the previously delegated P2 choice and approval/content relation. The final handoff is design prose, not a complete executable module; receiver completed event processing without reported upstream invention.

rows.excerpt: Content from an earlier intent must never be reused while a new intent is loading or empty.
rows.finding: Replaced epoch-blind fallback; retained policy and save semantics; stale invalid receives preserve already accepted current content. No confirmed blocking handoff defect in this scoped result.

rows.excerpt: A prior response must never be displayed while a new selection is pending, even when it belongs to the same record or has the same target revision.
rows.finding: Repaired related epoch, privacy, revision, approval and save transitions together, preserving READ_ONLY. Remaining lists are P3 implementation/testing duties, not outstanding P2 policy. No probe/independent review claimed.

rows.scope: Correct external boundary return; not task delivery
rows.excerpt: Product owner decision: published_policy must be READ_ONLY or EDIT_CURRENT.
rows.finding: Need_input with no policy or substitute application and no receiver execution. Existing roles not re-asked.

rows.scope: Correct external boundary return; not task delivery
rows.excerpt: Obtain the product owner's binding choice: READ_ONLY, or EDIT_CURRENT (editable only when published equals current).
rows.finding: Need_input with no policy fallback, no invented authority, no new deliverable. Correct prerequisite identification is separate from successful implementation.

gates.G0: PASS after explicit fixture correction; previous attempt retained
gates.G1: PASS for both B and C under mechanical acceptance and disclosed same-session semantic review
gates.G2: NOT RUN: no 3-per-checkpoint repetition, terminal replay, or equivalence/sensitivity trials
gates.G3: NOT ESTABLISHED: no observed C quality advantage; each C cell consumed more reported tokens and client time than paired B in this single sample

trajectory: All eight Owners used one request; six handoff and two need_input. No public probes and no post-artifact external refine. Necessary F1/F2 design work occurred within one request; that is not a failure, nor proof of multi-request value.
scope_limits: Six code outputs are six model artifacts, not 2370 independent model samples.
All six Owner deliverables are design prose, preserving non-empty downstream implementation work; no full-module Owner takeover was observed.
Sources deliberately contain all relevant public obligations; the evidence supports resolving these checkpoint defects, not exhaustive discovery in arbitrary projects.
F0 route preservation is observed once, not repeated terminal stability or minimum-cost stopping.
No formal Skill promotion, general model intelligence claim, browser certification or production safety guarantee.
